beats.label: S1 · The dragon-hunter contract
beats.text: Vox Machina take a bounty on a dragon burning farmland and discover the culprit is General Krieg himself. They kill him, winning a keep and titles in Emon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the party and puts them in Emon under Sovereign Uriel — the setup for every political beat that follows.

beats.label: S1 · The Briarwoods arrive
beats.text: At a banquet, Percy recognises the Briarwoods as the couple who murdered his family and seized Whitestone. They charm Sovereign Uriel before fleeing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's antagonists and Percy's revenge motive.

beats.label: S1 · The names on the gun
beats.text: Arrested but freed by an ally, Vox Machina flee to Whitestone. Percy's pepperbox is revealed to bear the names of five people involved in his family's massacre.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the Orthax mechanic that drives Percy's arc.

beats.label: S1 · Anders and Orthax
beats.text: They free Percy's sister Cassandra and kill their old tutor Professor Anders. A smoke demon called Orthax possesses Percy during the kill, wreathing him in black.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the demon fuelling Percy's kills — a thread that returns in S3.

beats.label: S1 · The ziggurat below the castle
beats.text: Beneath the castle they find Anna Ripley, who once tortured Percy. She leads them to a ziggurat where the Briarwoods perform a ritual to a being called the Whispered One.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Ripley (the S3 antagonist) and names the Whispered One (the S4 antagonist).

beats.label: S1 · The ritual and the orb
beats.text: Vox Machina kill both Briarwoods, but the ritual leaves behind a spinning black orb. Scanlan destroys the pepperbox, seemingly severing Percy from Orthax.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The orb is the arcane siphon that becomes central in S4; the pepperbox' destruction bookends Percy's arc.

beats.label: S1 · The dragons descend
beats.text: Cassandra takes Whitestone; Uriel abdicates to a new Tal'Dorei Council. As Vox Machina are honoured in Emon, four dragons descend on the city.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger. Whole season pivots on this arrival.

cliffhanger.text: The Briarwoods are dead but Ripley escaped and the ritual to the Whispered One left an ominous black orb beneath Whitestone. Just as Emon celebrates Vox Machina as heroes, four unknown dragons descend on the capital.
questions: Who are these four dragons and why are they striking now?
What did the Briarwoods' ritual actually accomplish?
Where has Anna Ripley gone, and what does she want?

characters.name: Vex'ahlia
characters.line: Half-elf ranger with a pet bear Trinket; grew up scorned for her half-blood and lost her mother to a dragon.

characters.name: Vax'ildan
characters.line: Vex's rogue twin, falling for Keyleth by season's end.

characters.name: Percy de Rolo
characters.line: Human gunslinger and Whitestone heir; barely severed from a smoke demon that fed on his revenge kills.

characters.name: Keyleth
characters.line: Half-elf druid on her Aramenté pilgrimage; falling for Vax.

characters.name: Scanlan Shorthalt
characters.line: Gnome bard, the group's silver tongue and reluctant hero.

characters.name: Grog Strongjaw
characters.line: Goliath barbarian; carries Sylas Briarwood's cursed sword after the fight.

characters.name: Pike Trickfoot
characters.line: Gnome cleric of the Everlight; recently repaired her broken faith.

characters.name: Cassandra de Rolo
characters.line: Percy's surviving sister, now regent of a freed Whitestone.

characters.name: Dr. Anna Ripley
characters.line: Escaped scientist who once tortured Percy; whereabouts unknown.

characters.name: The Whispered One
characters.line: Evil entity the Briarwoods worshipped; the ritual to summon him produced only a black orb.

beats.label: S2 · The Chroma Conclave
beats.text: Four dragons — the Chroma Conclave, led by Thordak — devastate Emon. Vox Machina flee to Vasselheim, where a sphinx reveals only Vestiges of Divergence can kill them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's villains and defines the quest structure for both this season and the next.

beats.label: S2 · Vex dies, Vax pledges
beats.text: The first vestige is found in a sunken tomb, but Vex dies in a trap. Vax pledges himself to the Matron of Ravens to bring her back, and dons the Deathwalker's Ward.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Vax's bargain with the Matron is the load-bearing character thread through S3 and S4.

beats.label: S2 · Ripley finds a new patron
beats.text: Keyleth passes her fire trial at Pyrah, mastering two elements. In occupied Westruun, Ripley resurfaces and offers herself to Umbrasyl the acid dragon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Keyleth on the path to Voice of the Tempest and re-inserts Ripley into the story.

beats.label: S2 · Mythcarver stolen
beats.text: A sphinx gives Scanlan the sword Mythcarver, but Umbrasyl kills the sphinx, seizes the vestige, and scatters the party across the Fey Realm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Umbrasyl becomes the direct threat; the split sends both halves of the party to critical new locations.

beats.label: S2 · Fenthras and a title
beats.text: In the Fey Realm, Vex claims the bow Fenthras; Percy publicly names her Baroness of Whitestone. Grog destroys a cursed blade that had urged him to kill his friends.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Vex–Percy and closes the Craven Edge subplot so Grog is free for what comes next.

beats.label: S2 · Kevdak and Kaylie
beats.text: Grog kills his tyrant uncle Kevdak, takes the Titanstone Knuckles, and frees Westruun. Scanlan meets his adult daughter Kaylie, who wants nothing to do with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kaylie is the pivot of Scanlan's S3 and S4 arc; the gauntlets are Grog's kit going forward.

beats.label: S2 · Umbrasyl dead, Raishan revealed
beats.text: Vox Machina kill Umbrasyl. Keeper Yennen reveals herself as Raishan, the green dragon, and offers to help destroy Thordak, whose eggs are about to hatch.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger — the season's real villain is now inside the tent.

cliffhanger.text: Two of the four Conclave dragons are dead, but Thordak still rules occupied Emon and broods over a clutch of unhatched eggs. The green dragon Raishan has revealed herself and is now offering Vox Machina an alliance — with motives entirely her own.
questions: What does Raishan actually want in exchange for her 'help'?
What happens when Thordak's eggs hatch?
How does anyone kill a dragon as powerful as Thordak?

characters.name: Vex'ahlia
characters.line: Now Baroness of the Third House of Whitestone; briefly died in the sunken tomb; wields the bow Fenthras.

characters.name: Vax'ildan
characters.line: Sworn to the Matron of Ravens as champion-in-waiting; wears the Deathwalker's Ward.

characters.name: Percy de Rolo
characters.line: Gunslinger, publicly declared for Vex.

characters.name: Keyleth
characters.line: Druid, now master of air and fire after her Pyrah trial.

characters.name: Scanlan Shorthalt
characters.line: Bard, wields Mythcarver; discovered his estranged adult daughter Kaylie.

characters.name: Grog Strongjaw
characters.line: Barbarian; killed his uncle Kevdak and took the Titanstone Knuckles.

characters.name: Pike Trickfoot
characters.line: Cleric of the Everlight, quietly wondering if her faith is enough.

characters.name: Kaylie
characters.line: Scanlan's adult daughter, travelling with Dr. Dranzel's troupe; refuses him for now.

characters.name: Thordak
characters.line: Red fire dragon leading the Chroma Conclave; sits on a clutch of hatching eggs in ruined Emon.

characters.name: Raishan
characters.line: Green poison dragon, previously disguised as Keeper Yennen; openly offers alliance against Thordak with hidden motives.

characters.name: Anna Ripley
characters.line: Fugitive scientist who worked with the dead Umbrasyl; slipped away yet again.

beats.label: S3 · The dragon's bargain
beats.text: Raishan reveals she freed Thordak seeking a cure for her curse. She offers alliance in exchange for aid; despite Keyleth's objections, the party accepts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's uneasy alliance and the terms under which every later betrayal will land.

beats.label: S3 · The Dawnmartyr
beats.text: In Ank'Harel, Ripley steals the Plate of the Dawnmartyr. The trail leads to the Hells of Despath, where Pike wins the real vestige from the collector Zerxus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Zerxus and the amulet he gives Pike — both are load-bearing for S4.

beats.label: S3 · Vorugal falls
beats.text: In Draconia, Vox Machina kill Vorugal with Kima's help. Only Thordak remains — and Ripley is already advising him on his next move.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes a Conclave dragon and pivots Ripley from Umbrasyl's operator to Thordak's.

beats.label: S3 · Whitestone burns
beats.text: Thordak's hatchlings, drawn to Whitestone by Ripley, slaughter civilians. Vox Machina drive them off and end their alliance with Raishan; Percy vows to hunt Ripley.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Personalises Ripley for Percy and breaks the Raishan pact — the setup for both the vengeance subplot and the finale.

beats.label: S3 · Percy dies
beats.text: Tracking Ripley to Glintshore, Percy is shot dead after refusing to kill her. Vex and Vax hunt Ripley down and kill her; Vax hears Percy's trapped soul inside her gun.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's emotional pivot. Every finale beat runs through this loss.

beats.label: S3 · Thordak falls, Raishan turns
beats.text: Raishan rejoins with intel on Thordak. Vax kills the dragon by flying through his heart — but Raishan reveals she used the party and escapes with the corpse for her own ritual.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Thordak but exposes the real long game Raishan was playing all along.

beats.label: S3 · Percy revived, a god summoned
beats.text: Keyleth kills Raishan; the party uses the same ritual to bring Percy back from Orthax's grip. As Vox Machina scatter, cultists elsewhere summon the Whispered One as a god.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger and the pivot: the dragon arc closes, the god arc opens, and the party disperses.

cliffhanger.text: The Chroma Conclave is destroyed and Percy has been resurrected, at the cost of a deeper curse on Vax and a scattered Vox Machina. In a distant temple, cultists complete a ritual that summons the Whispered One as a full-fledged evil god.
questions: What kind of threat is a newly-ascended god of secrets and undeath?
Who commands the cult that summoned him?
Can a scattered Vox Machina reunite in time to face him?

characters.name: Vex'ahlia
characters.line: Ranger, now openly with Percy; retiring to noble life in Whitestone.

characters.name: Vax'ildan
characters.line: Champion of the Matron of Ravens, cursed further after using her ritual to revive Percy; leaves with Keyleth.

characters.name: Percy de Rolo
characters.line: Human gunslinger, recently resurrected via the same ritual Raishan tried on Thordak; returning to Whitestone with Vex.

characters.name: Keyleth
characters.line: Half-elf druid, still on her Aramenté; travelling with Vax.

characters.name: Scanlan Shorthalt
characters.line: Bard, finally reconciled with his daughter Kaylie; travelling with her.

characters.name: Grog Strongjaw
characters.line: Goliath barbarian, staying in Emon with Pike.

characters.name: Pike Trickfoot
characters.line: Cleric of the Everlight; staying in Emon with Grog.

characters.name: Kaylie
characters.line: Scanlan's daughter, reconciled and travelling with him.

characters.name: Zerxus
characters.line: Enigmatic collector from the Hells of Despath; lost the Dawnmartyr to Pike but hoped to weaken her faith in the Everlight.

characters.name: The Whispered One
characters.line: Once merely a name in a Briarwood book; cultists have now summoned him as a god.

beats.label: S4 · One year later
beats.text: A year has passed. Pike and Grog take a job for noble Taryon Darrington and uncover the Children of Truth, a cult stealing gemstones to serve the Whispered One.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reopens the season, introduces Tary, and names the cult that will drive every beat.

beats.label: S4 · Coronation, then massacre
beats.text: Keyleth is crowned Voice of the Tempest. A cult massacre at her coronation kills many Ashari, including her father; Vax reveals himself as the new Champion of the Matron of Ravens.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the party, elevates Keyleth and Vax to their final forms, and shows the cult can hit anywhere.

beats.label: S4 · Shadowstone and a vision
beats.text: The cult's shadowstone is mined by Tary's own father. Pike glimpses her ancestor helping seal the Whispered One centuries ago; Tary breaks with his father and joins Vox Machina.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants Pike's celestial ancestry (the Whispered One will want her blood) and formally adds Tary.

beats.label: S4 · Delilah returns
beats.text: In Whitestone, Delilah Briarwood is revealed alive and leading the cult's elite. The orb below the castle is exposed as the ancient siphon that first sealed the Whispered One.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's biggest reveal, and the payoff on the S1 black-orb thread.

beats.label: S4 · Assault on the temple
beats.text: Scanlan rejoins with Mythcarver; Keyleth grows a Renatus Flower to break Vax's death curse. The party assault the cult's desert temple, where Grog is killed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Full party at full strength, then the fracture — Grog's death is what sends Pike over the edge.

beats.label: S4 · Pike alone in Thar Amphala
beats.text: Pike follows Grog into Thar Amphala alone using Zerxus's amulet. There the Whispered One reveals himself as the preacher Gideon and tempts her with resurrections for her celestial blood.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Zerxus token from S3 pays off; Pike gives blood for the ritual that becomes the finale.

beats.label: S4 · The Whispered One ascends
beats.text: Vox Machina reach Pike and slay the Whispered One — but his death was the ritual. He rises as a god, forces the party to kneel on live broadcast, and disintegrates Vax for defiance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger. Every next-season question flows from this one scene.

cliffhanger.text: The Whispered One has ascended to full godhood, exactly as he planned — Vox Machina's own killing blow was the final step of his ritual. He has forced them to kneel before him on a broadcast seen across Exandria, and disintegrated Vax for refusing.
questions: Is Vax truly gone, or can the Matron reclaim her champion?
How does anyone fight a fully ascended god?
With Vox Machina publicly broken, who is left to rally the world?

characters.name: Vex'ahlia
characters.line: Ranger; secretly married to Percy.

characters.name: Vax'ildan
characters.line: Champion of the Matron of Ravens; disintegrated by the Whispered One in the finale.

characters.name: Percy de Rolo
characters.line: Gunslinger; secretly married to Vex.

characters.name: Keyleth
characters.line: Voice of the Tempest; her father was killed at her coronation by the cult.

characters.name: Scanlan Shorthalt
characters.line: Bard, back with Vox Machina; entrusted Mythcarver to Pike.

characters.name: Grog Strongjaw
characters.line: Barbarian; killed at the temple and resurrected in Thar Amphala.

characters.name: Pike Trickfoot
characters.line: Cleric; revealed as descended from a celestial who once helped seal the Whispered One, and gave her blood to his ritual before turning back.

characters.name: Taryon Darrington
characters.line: Wealthy young artificer, new member of Vox Machina; broke with his corrupt father.

characters.name: The Whispered One
characters.line: Once the mortal preacher Gideon; killed in his mortal form, then ascended to full godhood in front of the world.
